description:
App to tidy up your desktop and Downloads folder. No file is deleted or overwritten, and every tidy-up can be undone. Free, Pro €7.90 once. For Windows, macOS and Linux.

It sorts the files that pile up on the desktop and in the Downloads folder. It moves them and never deletes anything. Available for Windows, macOS and Linux.
New light/dark theme button in the header; the app follows the system theme.
